snippet.title: World of Warcraft: Forever | New Horizons | Cinematic Trailer
snippet.description:
Step into World of Warcraft: Forever and embrace the call of a new frontier. Be among Azeroth’s most ardently adventurous adventurers when WoW: Forever launches on November 4, 2026, or pre-purchase the Skyborne Epic Pack or Warcraft Forever Collection to get an early explorer’s view of Azeroth when Beta opens September 17, 2026.

Learn more at: https://us.shop.battle.net/en-us/family/world-of-warcraft
